display: Institutional Form 13F reports are filed up to 45 calendar days after quarter-end, so reported holdings reflect historical quarter-close snapshots.
Hedge-fund-only convergence signals may reflect market-making inventory, statistical arbitrage, or options delta-hedging rather than long conviction.
Form 13F filings report long US exchange-traded equity and option positions only; short positions, total-return swaps, fixed income, and non-US holdings are excluded.
Descriptive institutional holdings analysis only; no forward-return backtest or predictive alpha statistical test is performed.
The discretionary subset contains 2 institutions (Berkshire Hathaway, CalPERS, Temasek Holdings), so a 2-fund discretionary convergence threshold represents a small sample.
